notebook.title: Live Notebook
notebook.subtitle: Ideas, discoveries, wrong turns, and breakthroughs. A notebook of the philosophy behind every commit.

pages.title: Why Scriptorium Exists
body: Scriptorium is where scattered thought becomes durable.
The Admin Notebook is private. The Live Notebook is where selected notes are allowed to breathe in public.
This page is not a blog. It is the public notebook sitting open on the bench.

pages.title: Admin Notebook to Live Notebook
body: The Admin Notebook is the authoring surface.
The Live Notebook is the publication surface.
The two must share the same page geometry so notes created in Admin arrive on the public page without layout surprises.

pages.title: Workshop vs Notebook
body: The Workshop records what was built.
The Notebook records what was noticed while building.
One is the artifact. The other is the trail.
